cast.name: 罗伯特·史密斯 Robert Smith

introduction: Curætion 25 stems from a June 24, 2018 concert which was captured on the tenth and final night of the 25th Meltdown Festival which is, well, curated by Robert Smith at London's Royal Festival Hall. This concert is a kind of interesting "chronological" survey of The Cure's albums, with the band performing one song from each of their thirteen studio albums in order (though the disc allows you to play the set either "From There to Here" or "From Here to There", and there is a bit of a "break" for some new material, as well). Anniversary offers a somewhat more "straightforward" concert (at least in terms of the filming style) that finds the band playing to a horde of over 65,000 fans in Hyde Park on July 7, 2018.
